entries.title: Undergraduate Researcher, Semiconductor Nanofabrication
entries.org: Pulsed Laser Template Engineering (PLATEN) Lab, University of Oklahoma
entries.mediaAlt: Sample wafer after photolithography and plasma etching in the cleanroom.
bullets: Fabricate high-aspect-ratio micro- and nanostructures with photolithography, reactive ion etching and pulsed laser deposition (PLD).
Deposit oxide films by PLD and run XRD on them, for research into IC fabrication without EUV lithography.

entries.title: Electrical Systems Engineer, Power Distribution
entries.body: Central power and communications board for SCR's IGVC 2027 robot.
bullets: Designed a 4-layer power, CAN and E-Stop distribution PCB in Altium: 12 V at up to 10 A to 7 ports, with INA220 current sensing on each.
Added P-MOSFET reverse-polarity protection with about 0.7 W calculated loss at 8 A.
Selected the 3.3 V buck converter and the STM32C092 microcontroller with built-in CAN.

entries.title: Peer Learning Assistant
entries.org: Student Learning Center, University of Oklahoma
entries.body: Tutoring at OU's Student Learning Center.
bullets: Tutor 250+ students per semester in Physics I–II, Calculus I–III and General Chemistry I.
Teach step-by-step problem-solving methods students can reuse on their own.

entries.title: Undergraduate Researcher, Data Analysis (Dr. McFarquhar)
entries.org: National Weather Center, University of Oklahoma
entries.body: First Year Research Experience with the cloud microphysics group.
entries.mediaAlt: Research poster on Arctic cloud microphysics from the CAESAR campaign
bullets: Analyzed NSF/NCAR C-130 data from the CAESAR campaign on how cloud properties change with altitude.
Compared water content, particle size and condensation-nuclei concentration from several probes against normalized cloud height.
Processed and plotted the data in Python (NumPy, Pandas, Matplotlib) for a research poster.
